positions.commentary: The speaker notes that large Indian companies were forced to stop using mainframe computers because IBM was thrown out of India in the 70s.

thesis: Based solely on the provided claims, this episode discusses IBM's historical loss of market share in India due to being forced out of the country in the 1970s, leading to a bearish stance on the company. The argument is limited to this specific historical anecdote regarding large Indian companies stopping the use of IBM mainframes.
